scripts.build: npm run build -w @airnobe/book-format && npm run build -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer && npm run build -w @airnobe/furigana
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @airnobe/book-format && npm run build -w @airnobe/book-format && npm run typecheck -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer && npm run build -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer && npm run typecheck -w @airnobe/furigana
scripts.test: npm run build -w @airnobe/book-format && npm run test -w @airnobe/book-format && npm run test -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer && npm run build -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer && npm run test -w @airnobe/furigana
scripts.test:real: npm run build -w @airnobe/book-format && cross-env RUN_REAL_EPUB_TESTS=1 npm run test -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer -- real-epubs
scripts.furigana: npm run build -w @airnobe/book-format && npm run build -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer && tsx tools/furigana/src/cli.ts
